title: Payoff Desk Guide, Retail Installment Contracts: Remittance-Method Days
content:
A Retail Installment Contracts payoff statement adds remittance-method days according to how the borrower has recently paid. The payments counted are those posted on the contract in the rolling **3** months ending on the quote date — payments dated later than the same calendar day 3 months before the quote date (the last day of that month when that day does not exist) and on or before it — whether or not later returned.

| Payments posted in that period | Remittance-method days added |
|---|---|
| at least one mailed personal check | **5** |
| no mailed check, but at least one one-time draft, card or transfer payment | **1** |
| only recurring autopay drafts or third-party remittances, or no payments | none |

The one-time draft, card or transfer payments are: a one-time bank draft through the phone line, website or app; a one-time bank draft taken by a live representative; a debit-card payment through the phone line, website or app; a debit-card payment taken by a live representative; MoneyGram; wire transfer; and certified funds.

**Hypothetical histories (quote date 20 May).**

- Autopay drafts on 1 March, 1 April and 1 May, and a mailed check on 2 April that was later returned: 5 days.
- Autopay drafts and one MoneyGram payment on 25 February: 25 February is later than 20 February, so the MoneyGram counts; 1 day.
- Autopay drafts and a third-party insurer remittance only: none.
